Verizon is in talks to buy broadband operator Fidium for about $6 billion

Verizon (NYSE: VZ) · Business

Fidium is owned by Searchlight Capital and Canada's BCI, according to the Financial Times Verizon aims to expand its network to 50 million US homes and businesses. The company wants a bigger presence in New England. A deal would let Verizon target more internet subscribers across the US.
